counting_rule: Count each real tactical CLI process and each fixed full-stage simulation at STARTED, including failures, timeouts, and external interruptions. Iterate at most three independent loops; stop immediately on an 8-ID WIN. No automatic retry, resume, replacement call, or historical balance transfer. A pre-STARTED authorization rejection without a model process does not count a CLI; a pre-reservation gate rejection without Simulator.run does not count a simulation.
non_stackable: M66 and all historical/frozen balances are not transferred; M52 V1 nine-operator WIN remains the frozen baseline until an M67 8-ID WIN is verified.
